methods.label: Separate full weeks from extra days
methods.explanation:
Every full week returns us to the same day of the week, so divide the elapsed time into groups of seven days:
\[
919=7\cdot131+2.
\]
After \(131\) full weeks, the day is still Thursday. The two additional days take us to Friday and then Saturday. The treaty was signed on Saturday, choice B.
